program.name: Almaty
program.description: Four nights in the old capital with a city tour, the Medeu rink and Shymbulak gondola, the Green Bazaar and the Rakhat factory.

1: Arrival at Almaty International and transfer to your hotel
Check in and the rest of the day free
Optional: the stalls of the Zelyony bazaar
Optional: an evening on Abai Square
2: Breakfast, then a guided tour of the city
The Monument of Independence on Republic Square
Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral
3: Breakfast, then up the Malaya Almatinka valley
The Medeu dam and its Olympic skating rink
On by gondola to the Shymbulak ski resort
Snow peaks of the Zailiysky Alatau above you
4: Breakfast, then into the Green Bazaar halls
Horse meat counters, dried fruit and spice stalls
The Rakhat chocolate factory and its shop
Optional: the Kok Tobe gondola for the city at dusk
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Private transfer to the airport for your flight home

expert.name: Aisha
expert.quote: Four nights is enough for Almaty because the mountains start where the city ends. You are at three thousand metres within an hour of breakfast.
expert.tip: Go up to Shymbulak on a weekday. At weekends the whole of Almaty rides that gondola and the queue can swallow an hour.

summary: Five days in Almaty with daily breakfast: a guided city tour, the Olympic rink at Medeu with the gondola up to Shymbulak, and the Green Bazaar with the Rakhat chocolate factory.
included: Included: 4 nights in Almaty with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; guided Almaty city sightseeing tour; day trip to the Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort; Green Bazaar and Rakhat chocolate factory trip; local guide; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Kazakhstan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
